caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box illustrated with a rural landscape scene. The primary colors are blue and green, with accents of brown and tan. The main faces of the box show a bright blue sky in the background and a dark green strip of land with various objects. Trees with dark green foliage and light tan trunks are scattered throughout the scene. There are two wooden houses, colored in tan with thatched or lined roofs and brown doors and windows. A large windmill, rendered in brown and tan with visible blades, stands in the center of the composition, with the words "RAIL ROAD" and "WIND MILL" inscribed nearby. Along the bottom edge of the box, there are three horse-drawn wagons facing right, each horse and wagon outlined in tan. The wagons are filled with rounded or squared cargo. The sky area on the top face of the box depicts two white sheep or similar animals grazing on a green pasture with some scattered trees, continuing the same color palette. The drawing is bordered by an off-white or cream background outside the box illustration.
title: Bandbox
